description: This file defines a class `PayGradeConfigurator` that implements the `MenuConfigurator` interface, used for configuring menu items related to pay grades within the OrangeHRM system. It uses traits and references other entity classes to manage menu configuration related to the HRM module.

classes.name: PayGradeConfigurator
classes.description: A class implementing menu configuration for the pay grade section, overriding the screen to 'viewPayGrades'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default screen for the current module to 'viewPayGrades'; returns null.
